# Veritrack

> Every delivery, verified and tracked. Veritrack gives every delivery a status, a rider, and a tracking code your customer can check themselves. It is built for small vendors and informal dispatch riders in Nigeria, with no app to download and no phone calls needed.

Veritrack was submitted under the Federal Ministry of Education's Student Venture Capital Grant (S-VCG) programme, supporting student-led innovation in technology and logistics.

## What it does

- Vendors create deliveries, choose an online rider, and send the customer a tracking link over WhatsApp.
- Riders set their availability, join a company fleet with an invite code, and update the status of each delivery.
- Companies manage a fleet of riders from one dashboard, and can see who is online.
- Customers check a delivery with a tracking code, and can rate it afterwards.
- Verified businesses can earn a blue tick based on account age, completed deliveries, completion rate, and customer ratings.
- Vendors can download a monthly report as a CSV file.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Tracking pages, personal location links, dashboards and admin pages are private and are not meant to be indexed or quoted.
- Veritrack is an early-stage product. Please do not state pricing, customer numbers, or features beyond those described on the pages above.
